name: Jungle (Oracle Mystery)
body:
Class Skills: An oracle with the jungle mystery adds Climb, Perception, Stealth, and Survival to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: ant haul (2nd), animal aspect (4th), mad monkeys (6th), explosion of rot (8th), blessing of the salamander (10th), whip of ants (12th), insect spies, greater (14th), animal shapes (16th), shambler (18th).

Revelations: An oracle with the jungle mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Chameleon Skin (Ex)

As a swift action, you can change the coloration of your skin to match your surroundings. You gain a +5 circumstance bonus on Stealth skill checks for 1 round. This bonus increases by +5 at 5th level, and every five levels thereafter, to a maximum of +25 at 20th level. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Distracting Mosquitoes (Su)

You can select up to two targets within 60 feet and fill their minds with the sound of millions of buzzing mosquitoes. A targeted creature must make a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier). On a failed save, the buzzing distracts the target, imposing a -2 penalty on attack rolls for 1 minute. During this time, an affected creature must make a successful Concentration check at a -4 penalty to cast spells. On a successful save, a creature takes a -1 penalty on attack rolls and Concentration checks for 1 round instead. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day for every three levels you possess beyond 7th level. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Eyes In The Sky (Ex)

You gain your choice of a parrot or kakapo familiar.

Your effective wizard level for this ability is equal to your oracle level. Your oracle levels stack with other class levels that grant a familiar to determine your familiar’s abilities.

Green Magic (Sp)

At any of the indicated levels, you can choose to substitute the green magic spell listed below for a bonus jungle spell listed above. For example, when you get your bonus spell at 2nd level, you could choose to take shillelagh instead of ant haul. Likewise, when you get your bonus spell at 4th level, you could choose to substitute warp wood for animal aspect or you could keep animal aspect, whichever you prefer, and so on at each bonus spell level.

Green Magic Spells: shillelagh (2nd), warp wood (4th), leshy swarm (6th), thorn body (8th), tree stride (10th), green caress (12th), transmute metal to wood (14th), fairy ring retreat (16th), wooden phalanx (18th).

Jungle Rhythms (Ex)

You have become so attuned to the sounds, scents, and movements of the jungle that you sense danger moments before it occurs. You add your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) as a bonus on Initiative rolls. At 7th level, you gain uncanny dodge. If you already have uncanny dodge from another class feature, you gain improved uncanny dodge.

Likewise, if you later gain uncanny dodge from another source, you gain improved uncanny dodge instead.

Jungle Tongue (Sp)

You can cast speak with animals once per day as a spelllike ability. At 7th level, you can also cast speak with plants once per day as a spelllike ability.

Life Leach (Su)

You gain the nature mystery’s life leach revelation.

Outback Survival (Ex)

You add 1/2 your oracle level on Survival skill checks. At 3rd level, you gain a 20 foot climb speed. At 7th level, you gain a 30 foot swim speed.

Quagmire (Su)

As a standard action, you can select one 5 foot square within 60 feet. You alter the terrain in a 20 foot radius of that square to become quicksand. Any creature starting its turn in the affected area must immediately make a DC 10 Swim check to tread water and stay afloat. A creature that succeeds on a DC 15 Swim check can move 5 feet, and a creature that succeeds on a DC 20 Swim check can move 10 feet. A creature can make two such checks per round. Failing the check by 5 or more means a creature sinks below the surface and starts to suffocate (see suffocating rules). Another creature can assist a submerged creature by extending some sort of rope, branch, or other tool for them to grasp, but they must succeed on a ranged touch attack to get the tool into the submerged creature’s hands. Once the submerged creature has a hold on the tool, the non-submerged creature must make a successful DC 16 Strength check to pull the submerged creature to safety. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 15th level. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Resinous Skin (Su)

As a swift action, you can coat your skin with resin for 1 round. For the duration, you are treated as though under the effects of the spell resinous skin. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + 1/2 your oracle level. You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Final Revelation

Upon reaching 20th level, your body takes on characteristics of the jungle flora and fauna. You gain the ferocity quality, and you are constantly under the effects of barkskin.

Lost Atlanteans, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
